revision_candidate.test_name: AC Reboot with CPLD Polling — Scenario Correction Required
revision_candidate.purpose: After semantic correction, run 250 true AC cycles and prove each required CPLD component returns with the approved identity/version/status.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact WAT/BMC/CPLD platform and approved isolated AC fixture.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Signed list of CPLD component IDs, board locations, firmware versions and health fields; generic BIOS/BMC inventory is insufficient.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Authoritative WAT scenario/flag order, cpldPoll mapping and execution location, AC waveform/dwell, CPLD baseline/allowlist, timeouts, recovery and approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Read package help and inventories only until corrected. Then perform 250 supervised AC cycles and record per-cycle CPLD/boot/management evidence.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Scenario and CPLD read method are proven non-invasive; AC/OOB recovery ready.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Signed semantics and package hash; AC trace/cycle ledger; per-cycle component identity/version/status; BMC/host/SEL health and final state.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: All 250 true AC cycles restore every named CPLD with expected status/version and no disallowed platform error.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not remove tokens by guess, substitute DC/warm reboot, infer CPLD from unrelated firmware inventory, clear logs or probe write registers.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: WAT/CPLD owner and qualified AC operator approve.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Stop cycling, preserve failing state, restore safe power and recover management by approved procedure.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unresolved flags/poll target, unsafe AC, missing/wrong CPLD, boot/BMC fault or incomplete evidence.

objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 keeps the warranted semantic block and adds component-level CPLD identity so an unrelated firmware inventory cannot falsely satisfy the future poll.
